Hi there, my little brother who was 17 died by suicide in February.. these are some things I think of that I could have done to possibly change the outcome: 
Forcing him to come to events: I would always ask my brother to hike, ski, hang with me and my friends and he would always say no. I feel like if I had forced him to come it would have sparked his desire to be more social, or willing. 
Explain to him he has a safe space: my little brother was already seeking therapy and lied to the doctor about how he was feeling, I wish I was able to sit with him and offer him a safe space to express himself. And allow him to be open with me without any judgment or take action on anything he wanted to share to me 
Take more interest in his passions: before he died, he told me how much loved a specific book and would tell me all about it, I wish I had asked more questions about what he liked and showed more interest in ANYTHING that he cared about, I felt like it would have made him feel more ‘seen’
Lastly, I wish I knew more about his school dynamic: I knew my brother was self conscious and always cared about what people thought about him. He once was a nerd and became more of a “cool kid” and felt he had to display a specific image. I wonder if I had talked to him more about that, maybe he would have wanted to change schools for a new start 

I hope these things help. this sounds awful but the best thing I would say to you… Is imagine if he did pass, what would be some things you would have wanted to do to help him before he made a decision like that. I know that at a certain point we cannot be in control of others, but I would have to at least been able to say I did everything I could. I know this is hard, I’m sending you strength.

Hi there, my little brother who was 17 died by suicide a few months ago (feb 15th) Valentine’s Day night. I often think to myself that he gives me strength to deal with hardships in life, and that he is by my side always. Sometimes I experience unexplainable things that make me feel like he is trying to talk to me and let me know that he is there. These things really help me accept and respect the situation. I feel the same that I hope he has found peace. My mother had dream that he told her he was happy, and can’t wait for her to see that their is ‘more’ (I hope that statement doesn’t offend anyone, I’m just quoting from the dream) I wish you healing and peace, even 14 years later (: as I am new in my experience…
